newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia sets up new Telecom company - agency.
newsitem.headline: Serbia sets up new Telecom company - agency.

text.p: The Serbian government approved on Tuesday the establishment of telecommunications company Telecom Srbija, Yugoslav news agency Tanjug quoted a Serbian information ministry statement as saying.
The decision was the result of a recently adopted new telecommunications law which separates telecom from the postal unit within the republic's monopoly PTT Srbije.
The government adopted conditions under which PTT Srbije can transfer to Telecom Srbija the right to conduct activities for which it is constituted, the ministry statement said.
The government also approved the appointment of Milorad Vucelic, vice-president of the ruling Socialist Party of Serbia, as head of the board of directors of the new Telecom Srbija.
New Telecom Srbija was constituted as a shareholding company.
No one was immediately available for comment either in the PTT Srbije or Serbian ministries. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 43 05
